articles.title: Anthropic says Claude used for cyberattacks and surveillance
articles.snippet: A Russian-speaking operator targeted more than 20 organizations, while a Mali consultant used Claude to build a mass-surveillance platform.

articles.title: Brevo login flaw enabled phishing email targeting 347K Trezor subscribers
articles.snippet: Trezor told Cointelegraph that the phishing email was sent to 347,000 subscribers and said it is treating every address as “known to the attacker and possibly reusable for phishing.”

articles.title: Morning Minute: AI Agents Cut BTC Quantum Attack Benchmark by 86%
articles.snippet: Crypto majors are shaky ahead of this morning’s CPI print, but onchain is heating up for another big potential weekend.

articles.title: AI Agents Just Slashed the Cost of a Quantum Attack on Bitcoin
articles.snippet: The ECDSA.Fail challenge cut a resource benchmark for one component of a potential quantum attack by 86%.

articles.title: Banks Have Minutes, Not Weeks, to Fix Flaws as AI Speeds Up Attacks: BIS
articles.snippet: The Bank for International Settlements says routine patching schedules are increasingly inadequate and cites guidance urging banks to accept planned downtime for urgent fixes.
